# Compiler-aware quotient vs per-fault emulation (generated by tools/binary_quotient_study.py)

Kernel `src/compiled/kernel.c`; IR model `polymul_karatsuba2_memory_model` (with explicit loads and stores). x86-64, emulated. Fault model: one dynamic instruction skipped. State ('0x53', '0xca', '0x1d', '0x9e'), all 256 challenges. Ground truth = every skip x every challenge emulated. A prediction is UNSOUND if the ground truth contradicts it.

## Coverage and soundness

| build | dynamic instrs | assigned to an IR site: template | IR site: checker-blind | cannot corrupt output | no effect | outside coverage | coverage | UNSOUND predictions |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| gcc-O2 | 895 | 229 | 7 | 430 | 47 | 182 | 79.7% | 0 |
| clang-O2 | 459 | 39 | 5 | 270 | 0 | 145 | 68.4% | 0 |
| gcc-O0 | 1372 | 376 | 14 | 611 | 82 | 289 | 78.9% | 0 |

## What the complete bypasses (wrong and undetected for all 256 challenges) were predicted as

| build | ground-truth bypasses | predicted checker-blind (correct) | outside coverage (not claimed) | predicted safe (UNSOUND) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| gcc-O2 | 7 | 7 | 0 | 0 |
| clang-O2 | 7 | 5 | 2 | 0 |
| gcc-O0 | 19 | 14 | 5 | 0 |

## Why skips fall outside coverage

- **gcc-O2**: 73 × control or stack instruction; 73 × perturbed value reaches an address/control use; 36 × no validated realisation point post-dominates the fault
- **clang-O2**: 123 × no validated realisation point post-dominates the fault; 13 × control or stack instruction; 5 × stale content left by the skip depends on the challenge; 4 × perturbed value reaches an address/control use
- **gcc-O0**: 171 × perturbed value reaches an address/control use; 117 × control or stack instruction; 1 × stale content left by the skip depends on the challenge

## IR sites with no validated realisation point in the binary

- **gcc-O2**: 13 of 29 (sites [9, 10, 11, 12, 16, 18, 19, 21, 22, 24, 26, 27, 28])
- **clang-O2**: 16 of 29 (sites [9, 10, 11, 12, 16, 17, 18, 19, 20, 21, 22, 23, 24, 26, 27, 28])
- **gcc-O0**: 8 of 29 (sites [10, 11, 18, 21, 24, 26, 27, 28])
